Combined with iter44 (11/11) and iter42 (28/29 — see CRITICAL regression below) total backend coverage: 50/51 = 98%. Frontend (Playwright on /leadership desktop 1920x1080): leadership gate accepts MASCIGC, /leadership renders 12 anchors (11 form '/new' tiles incl. equipment_return + 1 records), Equipment Return tile visible with bullets 'Look up by serial · auto-fills checkout' + 'Auto-flags damage / loss vs. replacement value', Safety Equipment tile present. /leadership/equipment_return/new page renders cleanly: title 'Equipment Return & Reconciliation', subtitle mentions scan/look up by serial/asset ID and auto-flag damage, Active Job + Employee + Position* (red asterisk visible) + Supervisor/Foreman + Date/Time + Location + 'Add Manual Entry' button + 'Look Up' buttons all rendered.

critical.issue: REGRESSION: leadership token is no longer blocked from creating supervisor_notes records — returns 200 (was 403 in iter42/iter44). The previous admin-only gate on supervisor_notes was removed during equipment_return changes. Verified via `git diff` between 30dc5ee and HEAD on backend/routes/field_leadership.py: the lines `if rec.get('kind') == 'supervisor_notes' and auth['role'] != 'admin': raise HTTPException(403, 'Supervisor Notes require admin')` were dropped, the `'admin_only': True` flag was removed from FIELD_LEADERSHIP_KINDS['supervisor_notes'], and the leadership-token list filter `f['kind'] = {'$ne': 'supervisor_notes'}` was also dropped. This likely also exposes supervisor_notes records in the leadership-scoped LIST endpoint (un-tested this round). See test_field_leadership_iter42.py::test_supervisor_notes_blocked_for_leadership for the failing assertion.

rca of the issue: REGRESSION RCA: Comparing `git diff 30dc5ee..HEAD` on backend/routes/field_leadership.py reveals 5 deletions related to supervisor_notes that were removed during the equipment_return refactor: (1) the `admin_only: True` flag in FIELD_LEADERSHIP_KINDS['supervisor_notes'], (2) the metadata-driven admin-only check `if meta.get('admin_only') and auth['role'] != 'admin': raise HTTPException(403, ...)`, (3) two duplicate explicit `if rec.get('kind') == 'supervisor_notes' and auth['role'] != 'admin'` guards in create_record, and (4) the list-filter exclusion `f['kind'] = {'$ne': 'supervisor_notes'}` for non-admin tokens. Reproduction: POST /api/field-leadership with X-Leadership-Token + body {kind: 'supervisor_notes', ...} → returns 200 (should be 403). Mitigation: restore the metadata-driven `admin_only: True` flag on the supervisor_notes kind config plus the `if meta.get('admin_only') and auth['role'] != 'admin'` check at the top of create_record (and the list-filter for the GET / endpoint). The equipment_return kind correctly does NOT need admin_only — leadership can file returns. Only supervisor_notes is admin-only.
